classroom.en: Our classroom is bright and clean.
classroom.cn: 我们的教室明亮又干净。

classroom.en: There are many posters on the walls of our classroom.
classroom.cn: 我们教室的墙上有许多海报。

desk.en: I have a book on my desk.
Please keep your desk clean and tidy.
desk.cn: 请保持你的课桌干净整洁。

chair.en: Each student has a desk and a chair in our class.
chair.cn: 我们班每个学生都有一张课桌和一把椅子。

clean.en: I clean my desk every day.
We work together to keep our classroom clean.
clean.cn: 我们一起努力保持教室干净。

tidy.en: A tidy desk helps me study better.
tidy.cn: 整洁的课桌让我学得更好。

poster.en: The poster on the wall shows our class rules.
poster.cn: 墙上的海报展示了我们的班规。

rule.en: Rules help everyone live and study happily together.
rule.cn: 规则帮助大家一起开心地生活和学习。

call.cn: 我们的班级口号很响亮。

call.en: We shout our class call together every morning.
call.cn: 我们每天早上一起喊出班级口号。
